how: Composed from OpenTofu v1.13.0's source and the SDK modules its go.mod pins (aws-sdk-go-v2 v1.43.5, service/internal/s3shared v1.19.37, smithy-go v1.27.7, hashicorp/go-multierror v1.1.1), not captured from a run: no live S3 backend is reachable offline. Rendered as the human view without colour writes an error diagnostic (internal/command/format/diagnostic.go:63-121: a box of ╷ │ ╵, detail lines not starting with a space wrapped at 75 columns, the summary never wrapped). The wrapping, the request ids and the S3 error messages are believed, not observed; the lock info's Who and Created are placeholders' values. T028 records whether the live diagnostics match; a mismatch is blocked, not a verdict. Placeholders: @LOCK_ID@ (the held lock's id), @PATH@ (<bucket>/<state key>, statemgr LockInfo.Path), @GIVEN_ID@ (the id force-unlock was given).
